<translate>
'''Dr. Gero''' works in [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero's Lab|Dr. Gero's Lab]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches no skills: his one service turns a [[Special:MyLanguage/Human|Human]] into an [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Android]], a permanent change of sub-race.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Dr. Gero works in [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero's Lab|Dr. Gero's Lab]], which generates once per world in the Rocky biome or in mountains. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 4 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero's Lab#Finding it|Dr. Gero's Lab]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Android conversion ==
</translate>
{{Main|Android}}
<translate>
Talk to Dr. Gero as a Human and accept his offer to become an Android:
* The change is '''permanent''': you can't turn back into a normal Human.
* It switches you to the '''Android form line''' (Android Base, Super Android, Fused Android), and you lose the Super and Legendary forms. Your racial skills change too.
* It isn't possible while you're fused, and the offer is locked once you're already an Android.
* Characters of other races can only tell him they're not interested.
</translate>

<translate>
See the [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Android]] page for everything that changes.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 18, ''Gero's Blueprints'': find Gero's Lab, obtain 16 Paper and talk to Bulma.
</translate>
